title: Campaign Knights: Taipei Street Campaign
heroTitle:
The city awaits
your next move.
heroBody: Lead your campaign knights through the capital. Spend your action points, navigate the streets, and break the opposition before the final day.
mission: Defeat every enemy unit within {{days}} turns.
missionDetail: Command a three-person Blue squad. Use class advantages, your commander’s shield, and field news to break the enemy line. Day and night share AP.
enterHint: Local single-player tactics · Progress stays in this page
endHint: Enemies move and attack when you end the night.
restartBody: Return to setup to choose your faction and commander. The saved campaign remains available until you confirm starting a new campaign.
mapSubtitle: Select a Blue unit, then a destination or an enemy outlined in red.
noSelectionBody: Select a Blue unit on the map or in your squad list.
pollNote: Display only · Does not affect victory
logReady: All squads in position. You have command.
logNight: Night falls. Your remaining AP is still available.
logDay: Day {{day}} begins. Both teams have recovered AP.
logDeadline: The 28-day operation has reached its deadline.
errorFinished: Operation complete. Redeploy to play again.
errorUnit: Select a unit from your Blue squad.
errorMove: Cannot reach that tile. Check barricades, occupied tiles, and remaining AP.
errorRange: That target is outside attack range.
errorAp: Not enough AP. An attack costs 2 AP.
renderError: Canvas unavailable. A playable simplified map is active.
victoryBody: Every enemy has withdrawn. This district is yours.
defeatBody: Your squad has been defeated. Redeploy and try another route.
deadlineBody: Day 28 is over, and the opposition still holds the district. Try a more decisive advance.
guideIntro: Select, move, attack. Make every action point count.
guide1: Select Blue units on the map or in the squad list.
guide2: Move to green tiles. Each path tile costs 1 AP. Barricades and units block movement.
guide3: Attack enemies outlined in red for 2 AP. Ranged units reach 3 tiles; cover does not block attacks.
guide4: AP carries from day into night. End the night for the enemy turn. Both squads recover AP the next morning.
guide5: Defeat all enemies before the end of day 28. Losing your squad or reaching the deadline ends the operation.
commanderRole: Heavy Lord · Your Blue Heavy Guard on the map
guardDescription: The commander takes no damage for 3 days, starting today. He cannot move, but can still attack.
eventQuietBody: No extra effects today. Watch for the next field dispatch.
eventBody_volunteers: Every surviving Blue unit gets 1 extra AP today. This is not repeated at night.
eventBody_rain: Movement costs 2 AP per tile for both teams today. Attack range is unchanged.
eventBody_spotlight: Both teams gain +5 base attack damage today, before class advantages.
counterBonus: Arrows point to the weaker class · +50% damage
logGuard: Jiang activates Capital Aegis: immune to damage for 3 days, but unable to move.
logAdvantage: {{team}} {{role}} exploited a class advantage for {{damage}} damage.
errorLeader: The commander has withdrawn. Skill unavailable.
errorCooldown: Capital Aegis is still on cooldown.
errorAnchored: The commander is holding Capital Aegis and cannot move while it is active.
guide6: Heavy beats Ranged, Ranged beats Scout, Scout beats Heavy. Advantages deal +50% damage. Red-outlined targets show predicted damage.
guide7: Capital Aegis costs the commander 2 AP. It grants immunity and prevents movement for 3 days, starting today; attacks remain available. Reuse after 6 days.
guide8: Fictional news events are drawn on odd days and last that day only. Even days have normal conditions. Changing language never redraws an event.
c_heroBody: Take your team into Taipei’s neighborhoods. Plan hex-grid routes, run community stages and contest landmark nodes. When the polls go dark, listen to the street.
c_mapTitle: From the corner to the city.
c_mapCaption: Choose a district and plan your next move.
c_newsDesc_rain: Every move costs one extra AP per hex today. Outreach and events remain open.
c_newsDesc_market: First visits draw a warmer response today. Daily crowd limits still apply.
c_newsDesc_volunteers: Each member of every faction receives one extra AP today, issued only in the morning.
c_newsDesc_clear: No extra movement costs today. Make the most of your routes and events.
c_hexHint: Choose a node for actions, or a hex to preview movement
c_canvasFallback: Canvas is unavailable. The interactive vector hex map remains available.
c_guarded: Capital Aegis lasts through day {{day}}: immune to mobilization loss, with movement locked.
c_skillDetail: Volunteer Watch lasts three days with a six-day cooldown; available from day {{day}}.
c_noPoll: The first poll arrives on the morning of day 2.
c_snapshot: As of the close of day {{day}}
c_points: Blue {{blue}} points / Orange {{green}} points / White {{white}} points
c_rumor_neck_and_neck: Reports from {{area}} suggest the front-runners are close; the outcome remains uncertain.
c_rumor_slight_lead: Street reports from {{area}} slightly favor {{leader}}, but things could still change.
c_rumor_clear_lead: Reports from {{area}} suggest {{leader}} has the stronger momentum.
c_rumor_insufficient_reports: There are not enough reports from {{area}} to tell who has the edge.
c_eventHelp: Prepare the announced topic. On event days, enter questions and rival exchanges, with a follow-up after each answer. Results settle once on completion.
c_noMoreEvents: Major events are over. Keep the final street effort going.
c_fictionalNode: This is a fictional nearby activity site for canvassing and stage placement.
c_wonderRules: At day end, hold this node uncontested, keep a team member nearby and complete a local activity. At most three Wonders pay out each day.
c_condition_rest_then_outreach: Bonus condition: rest before nearby canvassing.
c_condition_policy_forum: Bonus condition: complete a policy Q&A.
c_condition_connected_route: Bonus condition: visit two connected stops today.
c_condition_community_stage_event: Bonus condition: run a staffed stage event in this district.
c_condition_night_canvassing: Bonus condition: canvass nearby at night.
c_condition_livestream: Bonus condition: complete a nearby livestream.
c_condition_day_canvassing: Bonus condition: canvass nearby during the day.
c_condition_culture_exchange: Bonus condition: complete a cultural exchange.
c_condition_market_to_wharf_route: Bonus condition: visit market and waterfront stops today.
c_condition_neighborhood_visit: Bonus condition: complete a neighborhood visit.
c_condition_scheduled_policy_presentatio: Bonus condition: participate in a scheduled policy presentation from this district.
c_condition_environment_activity: Bonus condition: complete an environment activity.
c_approach: Reach this node or an adjacent hex before acting.
c_buildHelp: 治疏嶼 takes two days to prepare; Cha-Cha Soapbox takes one. Staff the stage once open, then actively run events.
c_crowd: Ordinary visits today: {{count}}. Maximum two, with diminishing returns. Stage sessions have a separate limit.
c_transportHelp: Once per member daily for 6 AP and 4 materials. Arrive at the district anchor or a free neighboring hex in the same district, within the connected map.
c_actionHint: Activities settle at day end. Use polls or street reports to assess the campaign.
c_logStart: The campaign begins. All three factions’ commanders, speakers and street volunteers are ready.
c_logNight: Night begins. Remaining AP is carried over.
c_logPoll: The day {{day}} poll is out, reflecting the previous night.
c_logFinal: The final night has settled. Actual results and history are now public.
c_guide1: Campaign for 28 days, sharing AP between day and night. After the final night, the highest citywide support wins; equal leaders draw.
c_guide2: Choose a faction and commander before starting. The other two factions act each night.
c_guide3: Select a member and destination, review the gold route and AP cost, then confirm. Rain, terrain and events may increase the cost.
c_guide4: Outreach and visits normally cost 2 AP and 1 material. Each location allows two visits per day, with a smaller second reward.
c_guide5: Fatigue reduces next-day AP. Rest restores mobilization, morale and health; watch your team’s condition.
c_guide6: Each member can transfer districts once daily for 6 AP and 4 materials, gaining fatigue. Choose the destination district before departing.
c_guide7: Build 治疏嶼 or Cha-Cha Soapbox, assign a volunteer after completion, then host an event. Each stage allows one event per day.
c_guide8: Wonder bonuses require uncontested control, a guarding member and activity in the district that day. Set priorities; at most three pay out daily.
c_guide9: Heavy beats ranged, ranged beats scout, and scout beats heavy. Exhausted members return to base the next day.

c_errorUnit: This member is recovering and cannot act.
c_errorNear: Reach the node or an adjacent hex first.
c_errorGuardMove: Capital Aegis or a braced formation locks this member in place.
c_errorRoute: Insufficient AP or no passable route.
c_errorTransport: Already transferred today, or movement is locked.
c_errorOccupied: The destination is occupied. Move its member first.
c_errorCrowd: This node has reached its daily visit limit.
c_errorVenue: This is not an available stage site.
c_errorStage: There is no friendly stage here.
c_errorStaff: Check that the stage is open and staffed.
c_errorBuilding: The stage is still under construction.
c_errorVolunteers: No volunteer is available. Dismantle another staffed stage to free one.
c_errorOnce: This action has already been completed today.
c_errorCooldown: The skill is cooling down or unavailable to this role.
c_errorRange: The rival is outside rally range.
c_errorEvent: No major event is available today, or you already attended.
c_errorMaterials: Not enough materials. Supplies replenish next morning.
c_skillDesc_jiang: Spend 2 AP for three days of mobilization immunity, starting today. Movement is locked; six-day cooldown.
c_skillDesc_shen: Spend 4 AP to disrupt rival rallies citywide through tomorrow. Rivals may still move and canvass. Create a local flank hotspot that settles once tonight. Six-day cooldown.
c_skillDesc_huang: Spend 3 AP to target a rival within three hexes and transfer up to 3 of their AP to your commander. A one-hex ceasefire zone around that rival lasts through tomorrow. Six-day cooldown.
c_trait_heavy: Armored: reduce incoming mobilization loss by 1. Brace for 2 more reduction, locking movement for the day. Counters ranged units at close range.
c_trait_ranged: Ranged: three-hex reach. Broadcast to the target and rivals in adjacent hexes; allies are unaffected. Counters scouts.
c_trait_scout: Scout: 18 daily AP. Reach one of the three adjacent directions behind a target’s facing arrow to backstab. Counters armored units.
c_facingHint: White arrows show facing. Approach from the opposite side for a rear flank.
c_noRivals: No eligible rivals are in range.
c_needRear: Move to an adjacent hex behind the target first.
c_targetGuarded: The target is protected by Capital Aegis.
c_errorRole: This class cannot use that tactic, or is already braced today.
c_errorRear: A rear flank requires a scout in an adjacent hex behind the target.
c_errorCeasefire: Signal disruption or a negotiation zone prevents this rally.
c_errorResponse: There is no available street event, or your team has already responded.
c_surpriseDuration: Fictional street event · Today only · One response per faction
c_surpriseDesc_heatwave: Ordinary activities here cause extra fatigue. Adapt to prevent the extra fatigue, or mobilize a volunteer for local momentum.
c_surpriseDesc_rumorstorm: Ordinary outreach here has a weaker response. Adapt to clear up confusion and remove the penalty, or mobilize a volunteer.
c_surpriseDesc_streetworks: Each hex here costs one extra AP to enter. Adapt to arrange alternate routing for your team and remove that cost.
c_surpriseDesc_nightfair: First ordinary visits here at night receive a stronger response. Adapt to organize extra outreach, or mobilize a volunteer.
c_surpriseDesc_donation: Adapt to coordinate the delivery and receive extra materials, or assign a volunteer to local outreach.
c_surpriseDesc_powercut: Stage sessions here cost one extra material and have a weaker response. Adapt to arrange backup power. Existing construction is preserved.
c_logSurge: The {{team}} Countercurrent hotspot settled at day end.
c_guide10: Heavy units can guard, ranged units affect an area, and scouts can flank. Check costs, range and cooldowns before choosing a target.
c_guide11: Prepare topics for forums, debates and stage Q&A. Choose each answer and watch for follow-ups and resource costs.
c_guide12: October surprises may occur on odd days. Review their effects, then respond or continue your plans.
c_threeSides: Choose your faction and compete with two rivals for Taipei.
c_autoSaveHint: Progress saves automatically once the campaign begins.
c_saveUnavailable: Local saving failed: storage may be blocked or full. You can keep playing; try Save now again later.
c_saveInvalid: The save is damaged or incomplete and cannot be resumed safely. It has been preserved; you may start a new campaign.
c_saveIncompatible: This save is incompatible with the current version. It has been preserved; you may start a new campaign.
c_overwriteBody: Starting a new campaign will replace the progress in Save {{slot}}. Continue?
c_guide13: Effective actions earn separate XP, capped at 8 per member daily. Movement and rest grant none; leveling does not refill AP.
c_guide14: Each faction can have seven members, including medic, organizer and logistics helpers. Recruits receive their first AP the next morning.
c_legacyTrail: This older save did not record earlier routes. Footprints continue from current positions; existing activity records are preserved.
c_guide15: Helpers support health, morale or AP within two hexes; each recipient can receive support once daily. Larger teams also use more supplies.
c_noMatchingLocations: No locations match. Change the filter or selected member.
c_plan_travel: Move {{move}} AP + canvass {{ap}} AP: {{total}} AP / {{materials}} material total
c_plan_ap: Reaching this location and canvassing needs {{total}} AP; not enough AP remains.
c_plan_materials: Canvassing needs {{materials}} material; supplies are insufficient.
c_plan_capped: Today’s ordinary activity limit is reached. Return tomorrow.
c_plan_blocked: Outside the current reachable area. Change member, position or use a charter.
c_plan_locked: This member is holding position and cannot move there today.
c_todayWalkCount: {{count}} walks today; numbers show their order.
c_noTodayWalk: This member has not walked today.
c_terrainCostHelp: Costs reflect this district, your adaptation and today’s weather. Water requires a passable bridge crossing. Route previews sum the actual costs of each entered hex.
c_guide16: Footprints mark visited hexes; checks mark completed activities. Cumulative marks persist. Cyan arrows and numbers show today’s walking order.
c_guide17: Choose one of three save slots on the home screen. Play saves to the active slot automatically, or save manually. Resume in the same browser and address; clearing site data removes saves.
c_roadsLoadFailed: Local road data could not be read. Hex actions remain available; retry to load the streets.
c_searchDistrictRoads: Find a local street ({{count}} named entries)
c_roadQueryPlaceholder: For example: 信義, 和平, 巷, 106
c_noRoadResults: No matching street names in this class. Change the query or road class.
c_roadResultsLimited: Showing the first 12 entries. Type a name to narrow the results.
c_roadsInHex: Named roads in the selected / centered hex ({{count}})
c_noNamedRoadsInHex: No named road is recorded in this hex; unnamed paths may still exist.
c_guide18: Polls appear on even days from day 2 to 14. Days 15–28 provide rumors only. Results and historical figures unlock after the final night.
c_roadAPHelp: Movement AP rounds weighted route distance up per 100 metres, with a minimum of 1 AP. Stairs, rain and unaddressed construction increase the cost. Check the preview.
c_roadRain: Rain adds one to the road AP distance multiplier; day and night share AP.
c_roadWorks: Fictional event: road sections in this district gain one AP distance multiplier. Adapt to remove your faction’s penalty.
c_guide19: Expand Keyboard movement preview to choose a hex. Tab moves between controls, Enter or Space activates them, and Escape closes dialogs.
c_buildingsFailed: Building data could not load; roads and actions remain available.
c_surfaceFailed: Elevation data could not load; roads and actions remain available.
c_surfaceProfileHelp: For landscape reference; does not affect movement cost.
c_surfaceProfileGaps: Gaps indicate missing data; movement cost is unaffected.
c_surfaceRouteMissing: No surface elevation is available for this route.
c_guide20: Audio & visuals enables sound, track previews and presentation settings. Accessibility & display offers larger text, contrast and reduced motion.
m_title: In the spotlight. Behind the screens.
m_intro: Adjust sound and visuals, or listen to the faction themes.
m_role_heavy: A sturdy shield and a neighbourly smile
m_role_ranged: Headphones, a laptop and amplified beats
m_role_scout: A sprout cap, leaflets and quick steps
m_audioIdle: Sound starts off. Enable it or audition a track to begin.
m_audioReady: Sound enabled. Leaving the tab stops playback; returning resumes background music.
m_audioFailed: Audio could not play. Enable sound again or check browser audio permissions.
m_rights: I confirm that I hold permission to use or adapt the imported audio.
m_importNote: Audio files: up to 20 MB, 1–600 seconds long. The first 20 seconds play; select the file again after reloading.
m_importReady: Local authorised replacement loaded and ready to audition.
m_importFailed: Import failed. Use decodable audio under 20 MB, lasting 1–600 seconds.
m_audioMuted: Muted. Enable sound to play again.
m_audioPlaying: Playing selected audio; background music is ducked.
d_finishFirst: Finish or leave the current broadcast first.
d_stale: That response is out of date. Answer the current question.
d_prepared: Your preparation applies here; you still need to address the question.
d_unprepared: Read the question and choose your approach; no real person’s views need to be guessed.
d_replyDesc_listen: Restate the concern and confirm the main difficulty.
d_replyDesc_plan: Name responsible teams, milestones and follow-up steps.
d_replyDesc_verify: Separate known facts from uncertainty and offer checkable evidence.
d_replyDesc_pivot: Make trade-offs explicit and agree on shared priorities.
d_counter_listen: Rival: You restated the problem, but who will deliver?
d_counter_plan: Rival: That timetable sounds neat. What evidence and limits support it?
d_counter_verify: Rival: Each dataset has limits. How do you reconcile competing goals?
d_counter_pivot: Rival: You listed priorities. What did the people most affected say?
d_followNeed_listen: Moderator: Return to the caller’s concrete difficulty.
d_followNeed_plan: Moderator: Add responsible teams and delivery milestones.
d_followNeed_verify: Moderator: Identify checkable evidence and what remains unknown.
d_followNeed_pivot: Moderator: Explain how competing goals will be prioritised.
d_reserved: Entry AP and supplies are already paid. Each question has an answer and a follow-up. Results settle once at the end; you may save and resume.
d_leftReport: Ended early and settled completed rounds. Entry costs are not refunded.
d_finishedReport: All questions are complete. This recap records dialogue without revealing hidden support.
d_question_housing_listen: Our daily difficulties get overlooked in housing arrangements. How will you first understand our needs?
d_question_housing_plan: Who will deliver housing arrangements, and when? Please give us a delivery schedule we can track.
d_question_housing_verify: There are many claims about housing arrangements. What is verified, and what is uncertain?
d_question_housing_pivot: Housing arrangements involves time and resource trade-offs. Which competing priorities should be reconciled first?
d_question_transport_listen: Our daily difficulties get overlooked in commuting improvements. How will you first understand our needs?
d_question_transport_plan: Who will deliver commuting improvements, and when? Please give us a delivery schedule we can track.
d_question_transport_verify: There are many claims about commuting improvements. What is verified, and what is uncertain?
d_question_transport_pivot: Commuting improvements involves time and resource trade-offs. Which competing priorities should be reconciled first?
d_question_environment_listen: Our daily difficulties get overlooked in environmental upkeep. How will you first understand our needs?
d_question_environment_plan: Who will deliver environmental upkeep, and when? Please give us a delivery schedule we can track.
d_question_environment_verify: There are many claims about environmental upkeep. What is verified, and what is uncertain?
d_question_environment_pivot: Environmental upkeep involves time and resource trade-offs. Which competing priorities should be reconciled first?
g_effect_medic: Restore 22 health and remove 1 fatigue from a nearby ally.
g_effect_organizer: Restore 15 morale to a nearby ally.
g_effect_logistic: Restore 2 AP to a nearby ally, within their daily cap.
g_assistHelp: 2 AP / 2 supplies; within two hexes. Each recipient gets one support action per day, shared across all support types.
g_recruitHelp: The commander may recruit support characters, up to seven total including the original team. New members arrive near the district base and receive AP next morning.
g_upkeep: Every two extra members reduce morning supply income by 1; a full seven-member roster still receives 6.
g_recruitLeader: Select an available commander to recruit support.
g_rosterFull: This faction has reached its seven-member limit.
g_assistRange: Choose another eligible ally within two hexes.
g_assisted: This member has already received support today.
g_noNeed: This member does not currently need this support.
p_bootLoading: Preparing your campaign map. The first launch may take a moment.
p_bootFailed: The map could not load. Check that the game server is still running, then retry. Your existing save is preserved.
a_preferencesHelp: Adjust the display to suit your reading and control preferences.
a_contrastHelp: Use white text on black with clear borders. Faction names and role labels remain visible.
a_largeTextHelp: Enlarge descriptions, menus and buttons. Browser zoom can be used as well.
a_vectorMapHelp: Use when drawing is slow; map controls remain available.
a_reduceMotionHelp: Keep static scenes and action logs while stopping interface animations. Audio is controlled separately.
a_mapKeyboardHelp: Choose a reachable hex and preview, then confirm in Field actions. Tab leaves the selector.
a_toConfirm: Go to field actions to confirm

a_feature_integrity: Secure data integrity checks (requires localhost or HTTPS)

s_confirmOverwrite: This slot is occupied. Choose Begin the campaign again to confirm replacement.
